tha-ap104:1.1: Ñāṇasaññaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ nisabhājāniyaṃ yathā / tidhāppabhinnaṃ mātaṅgaṃ kuñjaraṃ va mahesinaṃ // //
tha-ap104:2.1: Obhāsentaṃ disā sabbā uḷurājaṃ va pūritaṃ / rathiyā paṭipajjantaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ naruttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap104:3.1: Ñāṇe cittaṃ pasādetvā paggahetvāna añjaliṃ / pasannacitto sumano Siddhatthaṃ abhivādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap104:4.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ñāṇasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap104:5.1: Tesattati ito kappe soḷasāsuṃ naruttamā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap104:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap104:7.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ñāṇasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
